Overview

Toulouse is a city in Occitanie with a population of 493,000. The Pink City, a hub for aerospace innovation with Airbus, terracotta architecture, and a vibrant student life. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
